subject.title: refactor(talk): add realtime voice session harness and adopt in google-meet and voice-call

question: Should `createRealtimeVoiceSessionHarness` become a permanent public `plugin-sdk/realtime-voice` contract, or remain internal while the voice consolidation settles?
rationale: The factory exposes a broad orchestration abstraction whose lifecycle and type shape become compatibility obligations; tests cannot determine the intended long-term external plugin contract.

options.title: Keep It Internal First
options.body: Adopt the harness in bundled consumers without exporting it publicly until an external plugin use case proves the API shape.

options.title: Approve Public SDK
options.body: Accept the exported factory and type now with explicit ownership, documentation, and compatibility expectations.

options.title: Narrow the Export
options.body: Expose smaller stable primitives and keep aggregate session orchestration owner-private.

recommendation.title: Keep It Internal First
recommendation.body: Adopt the harness in bundled consumers without exporting it publicly until an external plugin use case proves the API shape.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available ownership signal is the same contributor's merged work across the preceding voice-stack consolidation phases.
